summary: deletedLines infers a deletion from a `-` prefix git also spells headers with, dropping any retired claim that begins with `--`
acceptance: a spec-locus line beginning with `--` that the window's range deleted reaches the sweep's retired-claim delta, and the diff's own `--- a/<path>` headers still do not
tests: the retired-claim delta carries a deleted line that begins with two dashes
pins: the retired-claim delta excludes the diff's own file-header lines
notes: Verified: `harness/gitRange.ts:264` filters `startsWith("-") && !startsWith("---")`; git renders a deleted `-- x` as `--- x`, so it is read as a header. git can say it outright — `--output-indicator-old=<char>`, git 2.22, under the engine's declared 2.36 floor (`src/git.ts:WORKTREE_LIST_Z_FLOOR`).
